source_receipts.publisher: Ripple / Standard Custody & Trust Company LLC
source_receipts.captured_excerpt_text: Ripple RLUSD User Terms, last updated October 14, 2026: Standard Custody & Trust Company LLC (SCTC), a Ripple subsidiary, is the issuer. RLUSD is recorded on Ethereum, XRPL and other Ripple-supported ledgers; each token is redeemable by eligible Customers for one U.S. dollar subject to terms. Reserves are segregated and may include short-term U.S. Treasury bills, fully collateralized overnight reverse repos, U.S. government money-market funds and deposit accounts. The terms say RLUSD is not the same as XRP, not deposit-insured, and permit freezing or burning addresses in specified compliance circumstances.

key_distinctions: SCTC, not Ripple National Trust Bank, is the RLUSD issuer under the October 14, 2026 user terms and October 26 Ripple announcement.
RLUSD and XRP are distinct assets. RLUSD can be issued/used on XRPL without demonstrating that holders or institutions bought XRP or use XRP as a bridge.
Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral availability was described as future at October 28 launch; do not mark it live.
Standard Chartered custody for RLUSD on XRPL was live; the LMAX collateral-mirroring integration remained conditional on documentation, testing, law, internal approvals and jurisdictional readiness.
BNY announced custody support for XRP and RLUSD, but disclosed no customer balances, holdings or XRP purchases.
SBI's Circle equity, Circle JV and ARC presale participation are direct Circle relationships; the amount of SBI's ARC allocation is undisclosed.
SMFG's 5% participation is in SBI Startale Marketing, not SBI Holdings.
SBI's Open Standard membership alongside Coinbase is shared consortium membership and a JPYSC/OUSD proof-of-concept effort, not a bilateral XRP partnership.
The SBI Visa card converts reward points into XRP; it does not establish Visa settlement or merchant clearing in XRP.
SBI/Startale/BlackRock's October 27 agreement is a basic agreement/MoU; production issuance, balances and settlement volumes are not established.
